episode_summary: In this episode, Greg Roeder shares how he grew his real estate business from $12 million to $40 million in two years without traditional advertising. He emphasizes the importance of building genuine relationships through community events and creating targeted content for dream clients. Greg also discusses how to avoid being an 'invisible agent' by staying top-of-mind with strategic branding and content creation.
